description: Corporate / legal-form / sector boilerplate tokens, stripped before the decisive 'core' similarity check so two unrelated companies sharing a legal form or sector phrase do not score as a match. Single source of truth for BOTH engines (screen.py STOPWORD_TOKENS and scripts/sanctions-match.mjs CORP_STOP), which had independently drifted to 79 and 58 tokens with only 42 in common — the drift cost the JS engine three hard-negative false positives on Turkish corporate boilerplate. Stored lower-case; screen.py upper-cases on load. Applied only to the COMPARISON, never to the stored designation, so list entries are never weakened.
